product_one_liner.value: Trackforce provides security workforce and operations software for security companies and enterprise security teams to manage guards, scheduling, patrols, incidents, reporting, billing and payroll.

pricing_page.notes: Public custom-quote pricing page describes selectable modules and pricing factors; no fixed dollar prices are published.

hq_location.notes: The current official job posting explicitly calls Dallas, Texas its headquarters. This takes precedence over conflicting directory locations; the contact page lists a Southlake office.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog contains security-industry, operational and product content, rather than a qualifying engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Public help centers cover multiple product modules, configuration, integrations and developer tools.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Enterprise Sales Director - NORAM and Major Accounts Account Manager, neither a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No underlying AI model or provider was identified in the public ReportPro AI materials, help documentation, trust/security pages, privacy policy, DPA/subprocessor list or AI-related blog and webinar materials reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 are claimed certifications/audits; GDPR is claimed compliance, not a certification. HIPAA and PCI DSS certification were not established.

last_funding.notes: Latest corroborated, separately identified funding round: September 2019. USD 150 million is the database-reported figure; K1 actually describes a commitment of OVER USD 150 million behind the combination, not an exact round amount. The June 2022 acquisition also involved an undisclosed reinvestment by TrackTik investors, not a separately disclosed funding round. CB Insights reports a later July 2023 Series B of USD 370,000, but no primary corroboration was found and other funding histories disagree; that entry remains unresolved.

raised_18mo.notes: No funding was identified in 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09. Even the disputed July 2023 database entry predates that window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Although the listing heading says Major Accounts Account Manager, its description explicitly says it seeks a Major Accounts Account Executive to drive new business and own the full sales cycle.

launched_6mo.notes: On June 9, 2026, Trackforce introduced Job-Based Views: five role-specific live views available to all TrackTik customers without an additional license.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Scott Kaine was appointed CEO on January 12, 2026; outgoing CEO Byron McDuffee transitioned to strategic advisor.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales posting requires Salesforce pipeline tracking; the Marketing Operations Manager posting describes ownership of HubSpot and integrations with Salesforce. The latter posting is readable but not listed on the current board.
